description: NHFLOW semi-implicit non-hydrostatic step with VRANS: regular waves (H 0.04 m, T 1.6 s, d 0.4 m) over a submerged porous bar (x 7-8 m, 0.25 m high, n 0.45, d50 3 cm, alpha 500, beta 2), 400 x 6 cells, dt 0.02 s, A 510 11, 600 steps. Porous and open layers in one column: the drag and the inertia factor per layer in the column operators, the pressure terms of the porous layers scaled, no fourth-order stencil over the porous columns, omega with the porosity of the swept volume (B 221 2).
covers: nhflow_momentum_SI_vrans.cpp (all parts) with porous and open layers in a column
nhflow_momentum_SI::ho_begin: no fourth-order stencil over porous columns
